title: Coffer, the skills you love up front
desc: Coffer's Board with the skills you love up front, three ways: a column per loved skill under the podium; a fourth, loved seat on the podium and a shelf; or everything shelved by skill, loved first and twice the size. Figures from Josh's own screen. For 1.1.

title: Home, glass tiles
desc: Home as glass tiles (Josh's sketch): square panes with a small gap, the whole window tiled like terminals. Two layouts of the same panes: Mosaic follows the sketch, Orderly puts every edge on one grid. Gap, glass or flat, and theme switches in the top strip.

title: Home, terminal
desc: Home, second pass on the Interface direction (Josh picked it): modern mono type instead of the pixel face, the app's own themes, a sidebar with the Mortimer icon, and the chat line as a command line that runs an action when you type the start of one. Type and Theme switches in the top strip.

title: Home, RuneScape
desc: Home, rebuilt from RuneScape's own conventions instead of a dashboard kit. Two directions: the game interface (bitmap numerals, right-click menu, orbs, a chat line) or the quest journal (ink on paper, done lines struck through, skills as a ledger). Swap ground shows each in light and dark.

title: Coffer runs
desc: A Runs section in Coffer, tree and herb runs first. Two directions: a board of your patches, or a log of runs tallied over the week.

title: Map goal tiles
desc: The popular goals under the Map search, three ways that are not pills: reward cards, colour banners, medallions.

title: Vault as the bank
desc: Vault as the bank. Two directions: the bank window itself, or today's Vault with the bank under it. Reads your real bank from the app; a wizard marks where your tabs begin.

title: Map tree-first mockup
desc: Map, tree first (Josh's direction). The tree is the page, search and the Optimal quest guide button above it, a popup per quest with everything in it.

title: Upgrades mockup
desc: Account upgrades read three ways: by skill ladder, by what they do, by stage. No tiers.

title: Map mockups
desc: Map, calmer. Two directions: one goal at a time, or one ready-now list.

title: Big upgrades
desc: Account upgrades as a tier list. Kept for comparison.
